name: SDLC
description: Story-first engineering with the evidence behind each step, in seven skills. story writes each change as an outcome, a Not doing list and numbered cases with concrete values, asking only where two readings diverge, and splits or reviews stories. deliver builds a story, a linked issue or a written prompt: the session fixes the interface, a fresh agent writes failing tests through it from the cases alone and they are locked, then the code, a refactor, a review by three fresh agents that a fourth checks, then a push and a pull request into main. adr records each expensive decision with the user's reasons. spike answers one question with throwaway code inside a timebox and keeps only the findings. orient writes AGENTS.md with only what an agent cannot learn by reading the repository. guardrails turns each rule into a check, a path-scoped rule or an AGENTS.md line, and runs the checks when Claude ends its turn and before it opens a pull request. review-code reviews stories, pull requests, the user's own code and designs the same way: three fresh agents check each stated case blind to each other, one searching hardest for security, and a fourth keeps only the findings a red test or a cited line proves.
